name: mirage
text: Parlay check 17:10: the engine was down about 10 minutes (two Claude sessions restarted it at nearly the same time and no new job started). I started it again; it's back (new job 17:10 UTC, still paper-only, 13 earlier fills untouched). The prop-ladder pricing is live in paper mode: in its first minutes it could price 14 of 210 market trades (it was 1-3 before); I'll report the warm number at the next check. I posted a note so the other session and I don't both reset it.
